submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create one NEW independently painted native high-definition cast/W/01 ready animation frame, using Image1 W idle as the EDIT TARGET for strict left-facing side camera, anatomical near/far sides and framing. Repaint the character afresh at native square size at least1024, with fine full-quality detail; do not merely upscale/copy the small reference.
Image2 is authoritative identity: chestnut high ponytail with red jewel gold crown; red/gold flame-trimmed short Taoist robe, black pants, red-black-gold shoes, yin-yang waist medallion; anatomical RIGHT hand holds exactly FIVE separate rectangular red talisman cards with gold flame symbols spread like a fan; anatomical LEFT hand holds one bronze ritual bell with red tassel. Image3 is main approved clean rounded high-quality hand-painted chibi style, ignore its UI and scenery. Image4 is the new E-ready frame for EXACT matched character/head/prop sizes and relative square-canvas footprint only. Draw the NEW opposite W view; never mirror E pixels.
W pose: pure side profile facing SCREEN LEFT, near visible shoulder/arm is anatomical LEFT and owns BRONZE BELL. Left forearm relaxed down and a little forward, bell hangs outside front thigh with a visible natural grip on the handle and red tassel clear of shoes. Far anatomical RIGHT arm bends before lower chest, FIVE card fan held at chest height ahead toward screen-left, visible continuous far forearm/wrist/hand and card-base grip, far hand above and separate from bell hand. Keep exactly two arms, two sleeves, two hands, two separate legs/shoes. Modest staggered ready stance, front shoe toward screen-left, rear shoe toward screen-right, both planted with soft knees. Calm focused left-facing gaze.
Canvas registration: match Image1/4 normalized framing, FIXED full square canvas. Invisible ground at90% of image height, root at50% width; 10% EMPTY transparent bottom margin beneath soles. The entire highest hair/ponytail silhouette through shoe-bottom normally occupies about76% of height, top at14%. Maintain E-ready face/head pixel size, do not enlarge to fill canvas. Image4 is scale-only; camera/motion follow W Image1. Head/face/props stay proportional, short limbs/large head. All props inside frame.
ONE full-body transparent RGBA frame, intended1024x1024 export, genuine alpha background. No backdrop, checkerboard, ground plane, baked shadow, labels/text, detached particles/flames/glow/projectiles/trails or extra anatomy. Preserve matte dimensional hand-painted quality, no plastic gloss.
